title: tdh.util.audioFileSm.ui~
description: `tdh.util.audioFileSm.ui~` is a flexible audio-file player with controls for loading, playing, stopping, looping, normalizing, and selecting playback start and end points in milliseconds. Its playback-speed control ranges from 0.1 to 500, with 100 as normal speed, lower values playing faster and higher values playing slower.
